Look · Remember · Say · Write

Little Animal
Detectives

Four adventures for curious little learners.
Find the animals, spot what’s missing, name the pictures and listen carefully!

Choose your adventure

Round 1 uses elephant, bird, pig, egg and chicks only. The elephant’s head and empty nest join Round 2. All seven pictures appear in naming, numbering and the word bank. Music starts after your first click. Headphones are not required.

Animal detectives

Find the elephant.

Our picture word bank

Point to a picture. Read the word. Tap to hear it.

Four playful rounds

1 · Animal detectives: Move the flashlight with a mouse, finger or arrow keys. Rest the beam on the named picture to discover it. The elephant’s head and empty nest are excluded here.

2 · What’s missing? Study seven pictures. One vanishes. Say its name and choose its word, or use Show answer together. A different picture disappears on each of seven turns. The elephant’s head is included.

3 · Name that picture: Say the picture’s name, then choose the matching word. All seven pictures are included.

4 · Listen & number: Press Next prompt to hear, for example, “Number one. Egg.” A student writes 1 beneath the egg using the drawing pen. Continue for all seven prompts. Replay repeats the current prompt. Use eraser, undo or clear as needed. Type numbers is an optional alternative. The answer key is for teacher-led checking; handwriting is not automatically marked.

Voice and music have separate on/off buttons. Voice off stops the current spoken prompt. The teacher can use Teacher script to read the listening prompts aloud. Welcome pauses the current round. Replay starts it again.

Teacher script

Writing is checked together with the teacher. The game does not recognise handwriting.
